conversationalSummary.text: Today is probably not worth chasing, even though Cantinho da Baia in the lunch window looks like the best available option. It’s mainly a mixed picture with the north wind crossing a bit, and the set period can feel fast and shallow around low/rising tide in the sheltered bay. I’d check Surfline or MEO Beachcam first before you head out, and only consider leaving if the cams look notably cleaner than expected—otherwise save the drive.

best.explanation: Cantinho da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Low confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 170 kJ, 10 s period, consistent 68/100, and wind is not fully clear.  A forgiving sandy bay with lots of take-off points; this is best for easy wave count and cleaner faces when the north wind is bothering exposed beaches.  Watch: 10-13s at low tide is fast and shallow in the sheltered bay.
best.shortExplanation: Cantinho da Baia is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide helps a bit, but the bay still needs enough push.
warnings: 10-13s at low tide is fast and shallow in the sheltered bay
